in_marathi.name: Dilkush
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dilkush हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit words 'dil' meaning heart and 'kush' meaning content or happiness. The name Dilkush signifies being deeply cherished or loved.
